long.vo: September, two thousand seven. India's biggest names skip the first-ever T20 World Cup, and the selectors hand the captaincy to a twenty-six-year-old from रांची. महेंद्र सिंह धोनी. What if they hadn't?

scene.sub: Handed India's captaincy for the first-ever T20 World Cup

long.vo: Here's what followed. The twenty oh-seven T20 World Cup. The twenty eleven World Cup. The twenty thirteen Champions Trophy. He's the only captain to win all three ICC white-ball trophies. Add five IPL titles with चेन्नई, and India's first climb to number one in Test cricket.

tiles.l: ICC WHITE-BALL TROPHIES: THE ONLY CAPTAIN WITH ALL THREE
INDIA'S FIRST TEST RANKING TOP SPOT

long.vo: Every great captaincy has sliding-door moments. The first came in the twenty oh-seven final. Pakistan need thirteen off the last over. धोनी hands the ball not to the senior spinner, but to Joginder Sharma. Misbah scoops, Sreesanth takes the catch, and India are world champions. Would anyone else have made that call?

scene.sub: Dhoni's gamble wins India the first T20 World Cup

long.vo: The second came in twenty eleven. The World Cup final at the वानखेड़े. India are chasing two hundred and seventy-five. धोनी promotes himself above an in-form युवराज सिंह, makes ninety-one not out, and finishes it with a six.

scene.label: PROMOTED HIMSELF ABOVE YUVRAJ
scene.note: Chasing 275 at the Wankhede · finished with a six

long.vo: And the third came in twenty thirteen. धोनी moves a middle-order batter called रोहित शर्मा up to open. रोहित becomes one of the great openers, and later India's captain for two ICC titles.

scene.sub: Later India's captain for two ICC titles: the 2024 T20 World Cup and 2025 Champions Trophy

long.vo: Now imagine the alternate timeline. Without the twenty oh-seven title, T20 might never have exploded in India, and the IPL launched just seven months later. रोहित might have stayed in the middle order. चेन्नई might never have built a dynasty. And twenty eleven might have gone very differently.

items.d: India's T20 boom, and an IPL launched 7 months later
One of India's great openers, never unlocked
Five titles that might not exist

long.vo: Our verdict? India would still have won things. They had the talent. But धोनी's calm, and his gambles, turned talent into trophies. No other captain in the world owns the full set.
